status: Development search on previously inspected clips; not independent accuracy
reference_protocol: Approximate source-image boxes reviewed by the agent in frames 40 and 80 of each clip. Score all output boxes whose bottom edge reaches y>=210 (Seoul) or y>=400 (Taiwan); all declared reference objects in those foreground areas are retained. Other image areas are unscored. Matching requires correct class and IoU>=0.5 with one-to-one assignment. Reference boxes and scoring areas are never used to filter predictions. No human-annotated track IDs or crossing labels were added.
reference_limitations: Only four foreground frames and one agent review; uncertain visible extents, partial occlusion and package-bearing motorcycles affect IoU.
Same known clips, no independent held-out validation; scores concern frame boxes, not the earlier 23 crossing events.
No real bus or truck reference target is present in this tiny sample; their recall/generalization is unmeasured.
selection: Lexicographic maximum recall, then F1, then precision. Exact ties: fewer reported false-object box-frames over the full clips, then lower sum of changed class cutoffs, then candidate name.

performance.definition: Frame age: completion minus scheduled arrival. Behind: completion minus the next frame deadline. Model loading precedes arrival schedule; first-inference startup is included. Every frame is retained.

summary.tracker_config:
tracker_type: bytetrack
track_high_thresh: 0.25
track_low_thresh: 0.1
new_track_thresh: 0.55
track_buffer: 30
match_thresh: 0.9
fuse_score: false
summary.timestamp_basis: zero-based frame index / nominal FPS; not wall-clock time
limitations: Single camera; temporary IDs are not unique visitors
ID switches, occlusions and long gaps can miss or duplicate counts
Variable-frame-rate input requires conversion to constant frame rate
